messages:
maya: Heads-up: canary deploy for service-infer v2.7.1 scheduled in 10m (change window 04:00-07:00 UTC). Follow the escape-hatch/runbook here: https://go/redwood/runbooks/escape-hatch-infer-v2.7.1 :eyes:

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: service-infer v2.7.1 -> prod. Commit: 9f3a2d7. Canary targets: infer-canary-[a..d]. TTL: 15m. /cc @maya @raj

raj: Thanks — confirming backout plan: if latency > 1200ms p50 or error-rate spike > 0.8% we abort and pin to v2.7.0, right? Also where's the quick rollback command?

maya: Correct. Primary rollback is pin to last stable image tag (v2.7.0). Quick commands in the runbook but copying snippet here:

```
# rollback to pinned image
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/service-infer service-infer=redwood/service-infer:v2.7.0
# force rollout
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/service-infer
```

ben: Add the emergency circuit breaker too — if request queue > 50k or redis timeouts spike, flip the feature flag and scale down canary via the router: `curl -X POST https://ops-api/route/scale -d '{"route":"infer-canary","replicas":2}'`

maya: Good call. Also: manual kill-switch path (only eng-oncall or release leads):

```
# kill switch: route all inference to fallback model
opsctl routes set-weight --route infer-canary --weight 0
opsctl routes set-weight --route infer-stable --weight 100
```

sre-oncall: I'll be watching infra metrics and the circuit breaker dashboard. If I see any SOS I'll call abort and run the rollback snippet.

raj: One more: can we pin model weights separately if we need to rollback code but keep new weights? Is that covered in the runbook?

maya: Yes — model artifact pin is step 2 in the backout checklist. Link to artifacts: gs://redwood-models/infer/v2.7.0 (we restore weights with `modelctl promote --from gs://... --to current`)

deploy-bot: Canary progress: 20% traffic -> infer-canary-[a,b]. No errors reported in initial smoke tests.

ben: Put a 15m hold after 20% and then proceed to 50% only if p50 latency stable and error-rate < 0.2%.

maya: Setting hold timer now. If anyone needs immediate abort use `@deploy-bot abort` or ping @sre-oncall.

raj: A couple of small asks for the runbook doc: add exact metric queries (promql) and the Slack escalation command examples. I'll open a PR after this.

maya: Great — thanks. If nothing odd in 15m we'll continue. Logging the runbook snapshot in the release notes: https://go/redwood/releases/notes/service-infer/v2.7.1/snapshot-1965432100

sre-oncall: Noted. Monitoring: apm p50, apm p95, request errors, redis timeouts, mem pressure, and multiregion latency. I'll post updates in this thread.

deploy-bot: Canary update @ 5m: health checks passed, cpu avg 48%, mem 62%, p50 latency 420ms, errors 0.03%.

maya: Thanks — holding at 20%.

ben: Annotated the runbook with the pin command and checklist step numbers 1-6. Quick checklist pasted below:
1) verify smoke (ok)
2) wait 15m at 20%
3) if metrics ok -> promote to 50%
4) wait 10m -> 100%
5) post-deploy sanity & release notes update
6) if abort -> run rollback snippet + promote v2.7.0 artifact

raj: All set on my side. Will watch metrics.

sre-oncall: 12m in: no anomalies. Keep going when ready.

maya: Thanks all. Proceeding to 50% in 2m. Remember: if any one of us types `@deploy-bot abort` it will pause and trigger the pinned rollback path. :warning:
